# rmux 0.1.16
Customize the terminal cursor and simplify the workspace layout from Settings.
- Enable cursor blinking alongside the existing Application, Block, Bar, and Underline styles. Typing and focus restore a visible cursor. - Show tab, split, zoom, and workspace-add controls only on hover, with space reserved so tabs do not shift. - Hide the in-window top workspace bar. macOS window buttons retain a drag area when the sidebar is also closed. - Enable a compact sidebar with single-row workspace names, icons, pins, and unread badges, hiding descriptions and other detail rows.
All new toggles default to off. Changes apply immediately and support Save and Revert.
## Downloads
Signed and notarized macOS Apple Silicon DMG and ZIP, Linux x86-64 tarball, and Windows x86-64 ZIP. macOS updates use Sparkle. All release builds run on GitHub.
The debug build and 40 preference tests passed. Native visual review remains pending; Windows runtime validation remains deferred.
[User guide](https://github.com/rmuxapp/rmux/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md) · [Website](https://rmux.app)
